note: Delivery and Garment District truck drivers (Carriers' trucks, flower trucks, ice trucks).

lines.text: Make way, buddy. Truck coming through.
Move your heap! I got forty racks and a schedule!
Come on! Thirty-Seventh's a parking lot!
Beep beep, baby. Big truck, small street.
You hit my truck? You hit my truck!
Watch the mirror! That's my good mirror!
You cut me off! In a sedan! Against a truck!
Wrong way, wiseguy! This is one way!
Get out of the loading zone! It's a zone! For loading!
Run faster, the truck's catching up. Kidding.
Double-park, unload, ticket. Double-park, unload, ticket.
Envelope on the dash. Don't ask what's in it. I don't.
Union driver twenty years. Augie don't hire amateurs.
Delivered dresses to Ohio once. They sent 'em back. Too New York.
Twelve tickets this week. Twelve! City's eating me alive.
Gas lines last winter, gas prices this summer. Whose idea?
Pushboys in the street. Racks everywhere. I'm a truck, not a ballerina.
Rain. Tarp the load. Tarp the load!
Wet streets, slow streets. Overtime nobody pays.
Cab's a hundred and fifty degrees. I'm cooking with the engine.
Lights out! Watch the intersection! Nobody knows who goes!
Ice truck to the fur vault? In this? Sure. Overtime.
Four a.m. Flower run. Then sleep. Then flower run.
You stop for a pigeon? A pigeon?!
Insurance is gonna love this. Love it.
Seventh Avenue before seven. Only time it's beautiful.
Augie's coughing again. Nobody says nothing.
Morning, Dwayne! Your racks are in the way. As usual.
Back it up! Back it UP! Okay. Good. Idiot.
Wet flowers. Mrs. Moretti says that's a feature.
Fur in July, ice in July, everything backwards in July.
You again. You gonna help unload or just admire the truck?
You got my truck out of the jam on Ninth. Beer's on me.
You hijacked my load! Off my dock before I get the bar!
Out of the loading zone! You ain't a truck!
I got a tire iron and a bad memory for faces. Except yours.
Take the truck! Keys are in it! I just drive it!
Easy, pal. It's dresses back there. Just dresses.
Forget it. Just stay off my dock.
Sorry? You'll be sorry. Get out of here.
